scope: CPU-only saved actual-joint transport geometry review; metrics transcribed from completed independent calculation, not rerun during report writing
method: MuJoCo same-asset convex signed distances at every actual transport joint-trace row, with each actual finger coordinate; FK cross-check against saved TCP. Environment leg exclusion used conservative per-geometry bounding-sphere minimum world Z.
limitations: Saved force_left/right values are control force, not rigid contact force.
coupling_trace records soft-constraint feedback; rigid pair metadata is not a contact record.
Geometric positive distances do not prove zero actual Genesis rigid contact force.
The 0.2 m between-arm result is capped by the distance query range, hence a lower bound.
Opposing-finger pairs were excluded by Planner; see independent-finger-clearance.json for separate dedicated audit.
No dynamic success, no causal certainty, and no GPU simulation are claimed.
